cosas.cosa: A small dense tuft of short lush meadow grass about 25 centimetres tall and 35 centimetres wide, made like a model-railway static grass tuft: a soft rounded dome of many short fine upright fibres packed tightly together, fresh spring green with lighter yellow-green tips, no gaps, no long blades, no seed heads, no soil.

A small dense tuft of short meadow grass about 25 centimetres tall and 35 centimetres wide with tiny wildflowers on top, made like a model-railway static grass tuft with flower flock: a soft rounded dome of short fine green fibres, sprinkled on top with many tiny dots of off-white, pale yellow and soft mauve flowers, no long stems, no soil.
